refactor(renderer): the renderer's acts and reads cross as notices and awaited calls (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.5ym) (#752)

* refactor(renderer): the renderer's acts and reads cross as notices and awaited calls (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.5ym)

Every reach the renderer makes into the host is now a notice (answers
void) or an awaited call (answers a promise of plain data), and a
compile-time check, Reaches, holds the whole host-call surface to that.

- The launch, the slash typing, the doctor's reads and install facts,
  the serving daemon, the client sightings and the idle confirm are
  awaited; the click's launch bound lives with the host.
- The idle clock's reading rides the request and the frame push, so the
  draw reads no host clock in place.
- A refresh answers each lane's time instead of filling a map it was
  handed.
- A record's undefined value no longer crosses, so a launch's env
  overlay unsets with null, which JSON keeps.
- The doctor's gather moves to a shared module the renderer side imports.

* fix(renderer): a busy probe crosses as data, a late refresh logs its lanes, and the crossing check names any (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.5ym)

- The doctor's rate-limited probes answer busy as data; the gather turns it
  into the click's refusal, so it survives a process boundary.
- A request refresh that lands after its answer writes a refreshed line
  naming the request, with every lane's time.
- Reaches refuses an answer of any; Crosses refuses undefined under every
  index signature, numbered and templated ones included.
- A journal turn is held from the head of its queue, so a slow gone() shows.
- The click gather's independent host reads run together; the doctor's
  reads are spread rather than copied member by member.
